item.title: New! The WHKP Radio App Now Available
item.description: WHKP is pleased to announce the release of its new radio app. DOWNLOAD IT FROM YOUR APP STORE TODAY! Features: Stream the WHKP radio broadcast. Check the local weather. Read the local news. Access WHKP on Facebook, X.com, Instagramm, and Tiktok. Text the DJs to request music. Listen to the WHKP podcasts. The app can be downloaded on your mobile device from the app store. Apple IOS Device - Dowload from the Apple Store Android Device - Download from the Playstore

item.title: BOYS AND GIRLS CLUB OF HENDERSON COUNTY NAMES LUNA TREJO-LUGO AS 2026 YOUTH OF THE YEAR
item.description: The Boys and Girls Club of Henderson County has named Luna Trejo-Lugo as its "Youth of the Year" for 2026. This prestigious title is the highest honor a teen can receive from the organization, as it recognizes outstanding leadership, character, academic excellence, service and commitment to a healthy lifestyle. BUILD HENDERSONVILLE NEW PARTICIPATORY BUDGET PROGRAM IN THE CITY OF HENDERSONVILLE
item.description: – The City of Hendersonville is making its budget process moreinteractive than ever with the launch of a new participatory budgeting program called BuildHendersonville. The City is setting aside $25,000 for residents to decide how the funds should be used to improve thecommunity.
